def structural_feats(g,r0,r1,c0,c1):
    H,W=7,7
    f={}
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1)]
    def nbrs(r,c):
        return [(r+1,c),(r-1,c),(r,c+1),(r,c-1)]
    def val(r,c):
        if 0<=r<H and 0<=c<W: return g[r][c]
        return -1
    f['iso0']=any(val(r,c)==0 and all(val(*n)!=0 for n in nbrs(r,c)) for r,c in cells)
    f['iso1']=any(val(r,c)==1 and all(val(*n)!=1 for n in nbrs(r,c)) for r,c in cells)
    f['deg1_1']=any(val(r,c)==1 and sum(val(*n)==1 for n in nbrs(r,c))==1 for r,c in cells)
    f['deg2_1']=any(val(r,c)==1 and sum(val(*n)==1 for n in nbrs(r,c))==2 for r,c in cells)
    f['deg3_1']=any(val(r,c)==1 and sum(val(*n)==1 for n in nbrs(r,c))==3 for r,c in cells)
    f['turn']=any(val(r,c)==1 and sum(val(*n)==1 for n in nbrs(r,c))==2 and
                  ((val(r+1,c)==1 and val(r,c+1)==1) or (val(r+1,c)==1 and val(r,c-1)==1) or
                   (val(r-1,c)==1 and val(r,c+1)==1) or (val(r-1,c)==1 and val(r,c-1)==1)) for r,c in cells)
    f['corner1']=any(val(r,c)==1 and r in (r0,r1-1) and c in (c0,c1-1) for r,c in cells)
    f['edge1']=any(val(r,c)==1 and (r in (r0,r1-1) or c in (c0,c1-1)) for r,c in cells)
    f['all0']=all(g[r][c]==0 for r,c in cells)
    f['any0']=any(g[r][c]==0 for r,c in cells)
    f['all1']=all(g[r][c]==1 for r,c in cells)
    f['any1']=any(g[r][c]==1 for r,c in cells)
    f['cross1']=any(all(val(r+dr,c+dc)==1 for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1))) for r,c in cells)
    f['has_spec']=any(g[r][c] not in (0,1) for r,c in cells)
    f['spec_iso']=any(g[r][c] not in (0,1) and all(val(*n)!=g[r][c] for n in nbrs(r,c)) for r,c in cells)
    return f

    cells=[]; r,c=r0,c0; n=0
